olist_customers_dataset: Table represents customer information (includes customer_id, customer_unique_id, customer_zip_code_prefix, customer_city, customer_state)
customer_id: Unique identifier for each customer, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: fad7d23c35cc53861ea7005b27cbeebf, 246ddb2dd49eae53ce1695190d61fc24
customer_unique_id: Unique identifier for each customer, different from customer_id, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: 87b17699dbb8c555f40463875ccaea8d, 6a1bd3531227937b0bf249d29fbf9901
customer_zip_code_prefix: The zip code prefix of the customer's location, data type: INTEGER, sample values: 49035, 96540
customer_city: The city where the customer is located, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: aracaju, agudo
customer_state: The state where the customer is located, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: SE, RS
olist_geolocation_dataset: Table represents Brazilian zip codes and its lat/lng coordinates (includes geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng, geolocation_city, geolocation_state)
geolocation_city: String, sample values: sao paulo, sao sebastiao
geolocation_state: String, sample values: SP, DF
olist_order_items_dataset: Table represents items purchased within each order (includes order_id, order_item_id, product_id, seller_id, shipping_limit_date, price, freight_value)
order_id: unique identifier for each order, data type: TEXT, sample values: '86c1a3ab2128e2448cecac7f29c5d48a', 'c4d2f075fc3bf3a06d1e68e113c35cbd'
order_item_id: identifier for each item in the order, data type: INTEGER, sample values: 1, 1
product_id: unique identifier for each product, data type: TEXT, sample values: 'aa995bbfcf2da055bed670f7282f90d8', '57e089e3103f5cda6a4ce23b77399bdb'
seller_id: unique identifier for each seller, data type: TEXT, sample values: '7a67c85e85bb2ce8582c35f2203ad736', 'aafe36600ce604f205b86b5084d3d767'
shipping_limit_date: timestamp for the shipping deadline, data type: TEXT, sample values: '2017-05-30 03:05:31', '2018-08-06 15:10:14'
price: price of the item, data type: FLOAT, sample values: 57.99, 54.9
freight_value: shipping cost of the item, data type: FLOAT, sample values: 16.66, 24.73
olist_order_payments_dataset: Table represents orders payment options (includes order_id, payment_sequential, payment_type, payment_installments, payment_value)
order_id: Unique identifier for each order, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: '9c9d443e386dc6332b14958d37eaf75b', '4db12ae1b5826c465cb48c30426fe425'
payment_sequential: Sequential number for each payment within an order, datatype: INTEGER, sample values: 1, 1
payment_type: Type of payment for the order, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: 'credit_card', 'voucher'
payment_installments: Number of installments for the payment, datatype: INTEGER, sample values: 2, 1
payment_value: Amount paid for the order, datatype: FLOAT, sample values: 172.17, 298.81
olist_order_reviews_dataset: Table represents reviews made by customers after purchase (includes review_id, order_id, review_score, review_comment_title, review_comment_message, review_creation_date, review_answer_timestamp)
review_id: alphanumeric identifier for each review, TEXT, sample values: '5cc99731674c4b5f4907c90be6906d68', '3338566cbe27d9977dc215eb193147e6'
order_id: unique identifier for each order related to the review, TEXT, sample values: '499e36ddc9a7c36dd44e2dcd43a76620', '77e3266e92eda8a0570ce5b1045fa3b5'
review_score: numerical rating given by the customer, INTEGER, sample values: 5, 2
review_comment_title: title of the review comment, TEXT, sample values: 'Beleza e funcionalidade', 'Aprovado.'

review_comment_message: detailed message of the review, TEXT, sample values: 'Almofada simples, bonita e bastante funcional. Gostei!', 'A entrega foi rápida, antes do prazo previsto.
O produto corresponde às minhas expectativas até o momento. Está em uso há 4 dias.'
review_creation_date: date and time when the review was created, TEXT, sample values: '2018-08-21 00:00:00', '2018-08-11 00:00:00'
review_answer_timestamp: timestamp for when the review was answered, TEXT, sample values: '2018-08-22 11:55:10', '2018-08-12 14:00:41'
olist_orders_dataset: Table represents order details including order_id, customer_id, order_status, order_purchase_timestamp, order_approved_at, order_delivered_carrier_date, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date
order_id: Unique identifier for each order, data type: string, sample values: '8ffd24fbf822586b2712a4becc7217dc', 'dd13617f642718bd4cdc450d197960f9'
customer_id: Identifier for each customer, data type: string, sample values: '2f9e8eaed5dc638e5b884a9a37268fca', '88cfdf24cd7c7e09f64d5673857f7ca7'
order_status: Status of the order, data type: string, sample values: 'delivered', 'delivered'
order_purchase_timestamp: Timestamp when the order was purchased, data type: string, sample values: '2017-01-29 00:31:42', '2017-03-17 20:28:33'
order_approved_at: Timestamp when the order was approved, data type: string, sample values: '2017-01-29 01:32:22', '2017-03-17 20:28:33'
order_delivered_carrier_date: Timestamp when the order was handed to the carrier, data type: string, sample values: '2017-01-30 09:11:53', '2017-03-22 09:48:04'
order_delivered_customer_date: Timestamp when the order was delivered to the customer, data type: string, sample values: '2017-02-07 10:34:04', '2017-04-17 15:44:48'
order_estimated_delivery_date: Estimated delivery date of the order, data type: string, sample values: '2017-03-20 00:00:00', '2017-04-26 00:00:00'
olist_products_dataset: Table represents products sold by Olist (includes product_id, product_category_name, product_name_lenght, product_description_lenght, product_photos_qty, product_weight_g, product_length_cm, product_height_cm, product_width_cm)
product_id: unique identifier for each product, string, sample values: 'a669398f595527fc03acc1ebda6b3cce', '19629b1460e380638d4b9263bd31547a'
product_category_name: category name of the product, string, sample values: 'beleza_saude', 'eletronicos'
product_name_lenght: length of the product name, float, sample values: 58.0, 52.0
product_description_lenght: length of the product description, float, sample values: 905.0, 1681.0
product_photos_qty: number of photos related to the product, float, sample values: 2.0, 1.0
product_weight_g: weight of the product in grams, float, sample values: 300.0, 10900.0
product_length_cm: length of the product in centimeters, float, sample values: 20.0, 75.0
product_height_cm: height of the product in centimeters, float, sample values: 10.0, 18.0
product_width_cm: width of the product in centimeters, float, sample values: 15.0, 70.0
olist_sellers_dataset: Table represents sellers fulfilling orders at Olist (includes seller_id, seller_zip_code_prefix, seller_city, seller_state)
seller_id: Unique identifier for each seller, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '88460e8ebdecbfecb5f9601833981930', '404e1ba01358af4cd63f679b2c4d1fa1'
seller_zip_code_prefix: The zip code prefix of the seller's location, data type: INTEGER, sample values: 87030, 36032
seller_city: The city where the seller is located, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: 'maringa', 'juiz de fora'
seller_state: The state where the seller is located, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: 'PR', 'MG'
product_category_name_translation: Table represents the translation of product_category_name to English (includes product_category_name, product_category_name_english)
product_category_name: Represents the original product category name in Portuguese, data type: string, sample values: sinalizacao_e_seguranca, eletrodomesticos_2
product_category_name_english: Represents the translated product category name in English, data type: string, sample values: signaling_and_security, home_appliances_2
